summary.text: Christian Bartulovich is the Democratic candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 122, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Doyle Heffley (R).
According to Ballotpedia, he is a U.S. Army veteran who works in healthcare management; in a Ballotpedia survey, he said he serves as a Penn Forest Township supervisor.

paragraphs.text: Christian Bartulovich served in the U.S. Army, graduated from Lehigh Valley Christian High School, and earned a bachelor's degree from Thomas Edison State University in 2017 and a graduate degree from Liberty University in 2023, according to Ballotpedia.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he worked as a paramedic before moving into healthcare operations, where he has managed a team overseeing service contracts in Pennsylvania, New Jersey and New York City.

Bartulovich said in the survey that he is a Penn Forest Township supervisor, has defended the township's zoning authority in litigation, and wrote a white paper on reform of the Municipalities Planning Code.
He also said he is head coach of the Jim Thorpe girls varsity soccer team and lives in Penn Forest Township with his family.
He listed local control, rural healthcare and emergency services, and property tax relief among his priorities.
Ballotpedia lists him as advancing from the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary as a write-in candidate.
